notes:
Background: long-time customer of SupportWave (their core CCaaS product) wants to centralize ML inference. Redwood pilot done Q4 — now expanding to contact center workloads across EMEA + additional US regions.

Key ask: agent-assist at scale (concurrent 6k live agents peak), reliable ticket summarization + automated tool-calls into internal CRM/ordering system. Must handle traffic spikes (holiday spikes similar to 2024 Black Friday).

Security: must sit in customer's VPC for PCI/PII isolation; KMS integration mandatory; SOC2 + ISO27001 previously requested by procurement. Data residency: EU tenant for EMEA region; logs retained for 365 days with audit trail.

Performance targets: median RTT for short-turn assistant responses < 120ms (p50) for text-only agent prompts, < 300ms for tool-calling workflows; sustain 80k RPS token throughput across multi-region routes during bursts. Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to pay reserved capacity if unit cost reduces 30% vs hosted.

Quote from Arielle (01/22 call): 'We can't have agents waiting when a contact spikes — fallbacks must be seamless, and the audit trail can't be lossy.'

POC notes: Redwood dedicated pool with KV caching reduced lookup latency by ~40% in PoC; observed degradation under synthetic 3x spike test — Carlos proposed autoscale/burst policy + canary fallback to smaller model family.

Sales/Procurement: procurement wants legal + security signoff by mid-March; finance pushing for 12-month committed reserved capacity. SE follow-up to validate p50/p95 latencies for voice->text->assistant path.

Stated blockers: final legal review, SOC2 evidence for hosted control plane where needed, and confirmation of EU data residency on Dedicated instance.
